item.title: Das Adam Smith Problem: rethinking Smith’s moral and economic worlds
item.description: Scholars view Adam Smith's philosophy as a coherent whole uniting ethics and economics, not a dichotomy between sympathy and self-interest. The Das Adam Smith Problem shows an apparent dichotomy between sympathy and self-interest in Adam Smith’s works, but most scholars now view it as a misunderstanding, arguing that his philosophy forms a coherent whole uniting ethics and economics.
